name: Dad Strength
display_message: +2 ATK. Decades of stuck jar lids have prepared him for open warfare.

name: Thick Skin
display_message: +2 DEF. Unsolicited feedback now bounces off entirely. He didn't even flinch.

name: Reads the Fine Print
display_message: +2 Perception. The warranty, the trap, the suspicious wall — nothing escapes the reading glasses.

name: Back-In-My-Day Wisdom
display_message: +2 WIS. The stories were load-bearing the whole time.

name: Second Wind
display_message: +14 max HP, fully topped off. He found another gear. It was in the garage, behind the gear.

name: Deep Cleansing Breaths
display_message: +4 max Patience. Four counts in, four counts out. It is not working. It is almost certainly working.

name: Suspiciously Good Knees
display_message: Knee pain chance halved. The knees have no explanation. He has stopped asking. Some gifts you simply accept.

name: Lifts With the Legs
display_message: Back pain chance halved. He heard this advice at 22 and ignored it for decades. It is, regrettably, correct.

name: Camel Mode
display_message: Thirst fills more slowly and the threshold is higher. Years of forgetting water bottles have forged this man into something the desert would respect.

name: Snack Logistics
display_message: Hunger fills more slowly; food finds you more often. The cargo shorts were load-bearing the whole time. There was a system. There has always been a system.

name: Note From Your Kid
display_message: +8 max HP, +4 max Patience. You step lighter through the dungeon. The note was in his back pocket since Tuesday. He does not cry. He does not.
